name: hackaTUM 2026
description: TUM informatics hackathon, 10th edition, company challenges and workshops
hours: Fri from 15:00 check-in; Sun final pitches and awards 14:00-16:30
note: On-site, English; application required, applications closing soon
details: Official hackathon of the TUM Department of Informatics, celebrating its 10th edition, described as one of the largest in the EU. Schedule: challenge presentations Friday evening, workshops on Saturday (e.g. Huawei, QNX), project submission Sunday 10:00. Mainly aimed at students; open to other participants per FAQ (unconfirmed). Price free per usual practice (not stated on the page).
